data.body: Phase C/D — ADVANCED investigation converged (convergence_score=2, both lenses agree). ROOT_CAUSE: the git add -A worktree-retention signal lives only in task-execution.md Step 8b (general-purpose template); the named dso:red-test-writer agent (plugins/dso/agents/red-test-writer.md), dispatched via red-task-escalation.md which does NOT inject task-execution.md (0 refs confirmed), has neither retention staging nor a no-commit invariant — and worktree-session-head-sync.sh's 'git reset --hard' leaves its tree clean — so its isolated worktree trips the harness reap heuristic and is reaped before Phase F harvest. The 907d check (per-worktree-review-commit.md Step 1a) is HALT-only (no recovery path confirmed). Incompletely-closed predecessor: archived bug 907d-7242-516d-49cc (same symptom; prescribed this fix as Option A but landed only the HALT defense). Hypotheses: H1 (red-test-writer.md lacks retention/no-commit) CONFIRMED via grep; H2 (dispatch omits task-execution.md) CONFIRMED; H3 (Step 8b retention is GP-only) CONFIRMED; reaping mechanism CONFIRMED by this session's observed incident (2 GP-staged agents survived, 2 red-test-writer clean worktrees reaped/lost). APPROVED FIX (auto, high-confidence/low-risk, no safeguard mod, no new capability): add a '## Worktree Retention (isolation mode)' section to red-test-writer.md instructing git add -A + git status --short before TEST_RESULT and NEVER git commit (mirrors task-execution.md Step 8b + the existing Session HEAD Sync structural pattern). RED test: structural-boundary assertion mirroring tests/agents/test-agents-have-session-head-sync.sh. Complexity MODERATE. testing_mode=RED. Defense-in-depth 907d recover-path deferred to follow-up; Phase G sweeps sibling file-writing agents.
